title: Research: added dyadic frame is unusable at every word length
body:
## Summary

```text
PR2112's fixed positive alphabet and endpoint
  determinant: sum n_F F = 4 I2
  trace:       n_R is divisible by 4
  PSD bound:   n_R <= 16/5 < 4
  conclusion:  n_R = 0, every exact word has 8 calls
```

Adds `research/bit-fifth-frame-determinant-obstruction/` with the written proof, exact checker, source pins and registered replay. The lower bound permits any finite number of restored dirty registers and free binary scalar mixing. It also classifies the five determinant-compatible multiplicity profiles.

Cinna Davis supplied the alphabet and six-call exclusion in #2112, following #2085. Philippe Van Velzen already proved the four-role minimum of eight in [Discussion2091](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2091#discussioncomment-18935374), at fork commit `b0b2cf8e30908e0285376c6d95e1114e55df26f6`. That minimum is not claimed as new. This independently proves the stronger all-length no-R statement and arbitrary restored-workspace extension, without repeating the predecessor's quotient search.

## Evidence

- Before, the published quotient search establishes the four-role exact-eight minimum. After, the short determinant proof excludes R from every exact word, at every length and every finite restored dirty-register count. The six-call candidate multiset already fails the determinant trace, `13/2 != 8`.
- Python 3.12.15 registered replay passes: 1,287 exact multiplicity multisets, six coefficientwise formal fixtures on 4/5/7 roles, 48 R-substitution rejection controls and seven CLI tests. Actual omitted-factor and wrong-lattice implementation mutants reject, including under `-O`.
- Python 3.13.5 optimized replay and warnings-as-errors CLI tests pass. All 144 research-workflow tests, Ruff correctness checks and committed-byte preflight pass locally.
- Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-fifth-frame-determinant-obstruction`.
- Started from canonical main `11720ce76c6d5e3e355d14f194f0e9bce90adbc1`, priority revision 5. Refreshed to `0706e744cbda1e4d0da5a6c569ad9b47876c6960`; relevant instructions, priorities, selected record and source inputs are unchanged. Final overlap has complete pagination of 489 open PRs, 2,115 closed PRs and 1,582 Discussion records. Arbitrary diffs are not covered. No advance reservation was posted.

Limits: fixed positive alphabet and exact restored endpoint only. Inverse labels invalidate the no-R conclusion, as the explicit cancellation control demonstrates. This is a written scoped proof with finite corroboration, not a proof-kernel verification or native supplier admission. No new kappa, selected-frontier change, independent human review or full selected cold replay is claimed. Hosted CI remains separate from local evidence.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way. One additive research package.

**Blast radius:** research. Frozen predecessors, shared tools and the selected frontier are unchanged.
